mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25% in 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which depresses consumer spending and corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 1% for three consecutive months indicates contraction in manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate revenue prospects and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by >1% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in consumer savings (RSAFS) by more than 3% month-over-month signals restrictive monetary policy coinciding with reduced household liquidity, which depresses consumption and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises AND RSAFS falls by >3% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during co-occurrence of the trigger at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly increase in the Housing Starts index (HOUST) above 5% for four consecutive months signals a robust housing recovery, which boosts construction-related earnings and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises by >5% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated rise in both payroll employment (PAYEMS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in the same month indicates a paradoxical labor market signal (e.g., population growth outpacing job creation), which foreshadows weaker earnings growth and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises >0.3% AND UNRATE rises >0.3% in the same month
regime_hint: demographic expansion with weak job creation
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered months at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent annual increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 4% for six consecutive months signals entrenched inflation, which prompts anticipatory monetary tightening and erodes real corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 4% for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods at 5% significance.
